entities.summary: Nicholas Joseph Zeisloft is an American former professional basketball player. He played college basketball for Illinois State and Indiana, and also had stints in Lithuania, Italy, Spain and Greece. Standing at 6 ft 4 in (1.93 m), he played at the shooting guard position.
